classification.difficultyReason: Calculate two rectangle areas, insert them into the explicitly supplied probability formula and simplify the fraction. The sequential prompts remove the need to discover the area model or choose a strategy.

content.prompt: A rectangular board is $4\text{ cm}$ by $3\text{ cm}$. The shaded target strip is $1\text{ cm}$ wide and extends the full height of the board. A dart hits the board and is equally likely to land anywhere on it.

spec.description: A 4 by 3 rectangular board with a shaded 1 by 3 target strip.
spec.mathematics: Whole area 12 cm²; target area 3 cm²; uniform probability 1/4.
spec.answerVisibility: Only dimensions and the target region are supplied.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Calculate the area of the whole board.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Calculate the area of the shaded target strip.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Use $P(\text{target})=\dfrac{\text{area of target}}{\text{area of whole board}}$ to calculate the probability that the dart lands in the target strip. Give your answer as a simplified fraction.
